title: Nine Feet of Testing
subtitle: 电路与环线 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 电路与环线（科学与技术·电子与器件）
meta: 主题语境：电路与环线（科学与技术·电子与器件）　|　核心词汇：circuit　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 circuit 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1962 my mother was sent to test ① circuit she could not see, and she said the testing was the whole of the lesson. The ② circuit, meaning the loop and not the machine, was nine feet long and was tested by whoever came last; circuit, she said, is the only thing in a box that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ circuit in that box had the same wire, and the ④ circuit at the end, meaning the one the engineer kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever tested properly. Circuit, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ circuit was the whole of the season, meaning the route it carried and not the loop. The ⑥ circuit, meaning the route and not any of that, is the only thing in a season that everybody follows and nobody questions; circuit, he said, is either something you test or the only word that means both a loop and a route. She said the route is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ circuit had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the wire. The ⑧ circuit of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine feet and eleven years of testing; circuit, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ circuit I remember is the one at the end, which was tested in 1982 and is still described as the longest in the county. A ⑩ circuit, my grandmother said in 1987, is the only thing that improves by being tested; every circuit, she said, is a route that has agreed to look like a loop. She said the route was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 电路（指那条回路本身，与那台机器相对）
C. 固定搭配：test a circuit 测试一条电路
D. n. 电路（指那个盒子里每一条）
E. n. 电路（指末尾那一条）
F. n. 巡回路线（抽象：它承载的那条路线）
G. n. 那条路线（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The circuit, meaning the loop and not the machine
circuit was the whole of the season
the circuit had become a number in a report
The circuit of the whole thing
A circuit, my grandmother said in 1987

answers.why: test a circuit 意为“测试一条电路”，1962 年母亲被派去测试她看不见的那条电路。
circuit 意为“电路、环线”，指那条回路本身而不是那台机器，长九英尺，由最后来的人测试。
circuit 指那个盒子里每一条电路，每一条都是同样的导线。
circuit 指末尾那一条（工程师保留的那一条），是唯一有人认真测试过的。
circuit 意为“巡回路线”，抽象指它承载的那条路线，父亲说 circuit 就是那个赛季的全部。
circuit 为抽象用法，指那条路线本身，是一个赛季里人人都追随、却没人质疑的东西。
circuit 意为“电路、环线”，到 1977 年这条 circuit 成了报告里的一个数字。
circuit 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英尺和十一年的测试。
circuit 意为“电路”，我记得的是末尾那一条，1982 年测试过，至今仍被说成全县最长的。
circuit 为抽象总称，祖母说一条电路是唯一会因为被认真测试而变好的东西。
